title: What drives opposition to data centers?
methodology: Percentages are from Gallup's March 2026 national poll (n=1,000): the share of data-center OPPONENTS citing each reason. Categories are not mutually exclusive, so they do not sum to 100%. Entries without a percentage are ranked qualitatively from the Data Center Watch opposition tracker (an industry-adjacent source) and documented case evidence; no public dataset categorizes actual hearing testimony by concern, so we do not invent numbers.
phaseNote: Timing matters: before approval, opposition is driven by power, rates, water, and land use. After construction, disputes are dominated by noise and generator emissions. A single chart conflates two different populations.
